about_vision.headline: Our Vision

about_story.headline: Our Story
about_story.p1: Telagri was born out of more than 15 years of hands-on experience in agricultural management and consulting. Working across large-scale projects in the Caucasus, one insight became impossible to ignore:
about_story.quote: Agriculture is one of the largest industries in the world—yet many critical decisions are still made without reliable data.
about_story.p2: That realization became the foundation for Telagri.
about_story.p3: To solve it, agricultural expertise was combined with deep technology experience—bringing together knowledge from agronomy, data systems, and remote sensing. What started as an industry insight evolved into a technology-driven approach to understanding and managing agriculture.
about_story.p4: Today, the team brings together expertise in agriculture, technology, remote sensing, finance, and startup scaling - building the foundation for a more data-driven agricultural ecosystem.
